body_html:
Hailing from Queens, New York, George K has had a storied entertainment background that includes singing, hosting events for radio disney and other premier events!  He loves music and bringing life to a party!   When George is not Entertaining and DJing, he also works as an actor and film production!
What’s in George’s Headphones:  He Listens to a lot of sing along songs, Rock, EDM, and Classic Hits!
What’s the best part about being a DJ?  Playing the unexpected song and having the crowd sing along!
